temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat; Gary says he cannot go because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated doctor and friend who might be under work stress, but he had not yet framed Gary's overwork as a serious health risk.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now sees Gary's overwork as unhealthy and believes Gary is unwilling or unable to step away because of hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworked to an unhealthy degree and needs help finding balance, but he is resistant or constrained by work obligations.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, worry, and some disappointment that Gary declined the invitation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain concerned for Gary and look for another way to help him reduce stress and regain balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. Ethan suspects there is more to Gary's overworking than professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was overworked and stressed by hospital demands, and that he had initially resisted taking a break, though now Gary is present at the retreat.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan's suspicion grows that Gary's overwork is not only about professional workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary may be dealing with a deeper, personal, or complicated problem that he is hiding to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and nonjudgmentally, learn what is really going on, and offer help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan learns the reasons behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had deeper personal or professional issues beyond ordinary work stress, but he did not yet know the specific reasons.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan learns that Gary's overwork is driven by new departmental responsibilities and personal challenges, and that Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork has specific causes, and with support he can work toward a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief and empathy, mixed with concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is not as overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change and still facing challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was working on balance and had accepted help, but he did not yet know whether Gary's progress would hold.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan's belief is confirmed and strengthened: Gary is making meaningful progress, though challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving toward a healthier work-life balance and is benefiting from Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue offering support, encouragement, and regular check-ins.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he could not have done it without Ethan's support and feels more in control now. Ethan sees that Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was improving but might still need support or encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now believes Gary has achieved a sustainable healthy balance and can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of maintaining his healthier work-life balance on his own, and Ethan's active support is no longer needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfaction and happiness for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
